crossRefs.note: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out…
But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: And from their cities they came together at Gibeah to go out and fight against the Israelites.
translations.kjv: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
